title: Array With Elements Not Equal to Average of Neighbors
goal: Rearrange distinct values so no interior value equals the average of its neighbors.
strategy: Place the smaller half at even positions and the larger half at odd positions. Every interior position becomes a strict local minimum or maximum, ruling out equality with the neighbor average.
